title: Audio buses, synchronization and analysis
summary: Route audio through buses and synchronize playback, analysis and scene timing.

blocks.text: Scene.audio lazily installs AudioPlugin and returns its AudioManager. The manager owns AudioContext, decoded assets, AudioTimeline and master/BGM/SFX/voiceover gains. Browser policies may suspend audio until a user gesture; awaitUnlock or resumeContext supports that path.

Web Audio buffer sources are single-use. AudioTimeline recreates sources when seeking or resuming and maps scene milliseconds to AudioContext seconds. Pause, seek, reset and timeScale changes need synchronized audio state. animateTimeScale is a real-time requestAnimationFrame helper and should not be assumed to be an offline timeline animation.

playVoiceover supports decoded audio and ducks the BGM bus through gain changes. Store narration results in the timeline so renderOffline can mix a WAV result for export. Real-time speaker playback and offline mixing are distinct execution paths.

AudioAnalyzer provides frequency and waveform sampling, named bands and GPU-friendly data paths. SpatialAudioComponent and AudioListenerComponent map entity and camera positions into Web Audio spatial nodes. Choose analyzer FFT size and update rate for the visual resolution needed; reading larger arrays than the shader uses adds avoidable work.

attachRecorder and getRecordingStream connect the manager’s mix to live capture. renderOffline produces a separate deterministic audio mix from timeline entries. Dispose the manager/plugin on host teardown so AudioContext, subscriptions and sources do not survive a discarded canvas.
One click schedules one short generated tone on the SFX timeline.
